init_gauditrainer: create a GaudiTrainer instance with a model, gaudi_config, and GaudiTrainingArguments for HPU training
train_gauditrainer: train a transformers model on Habana Gaudi using GaudiTrainer.train() with optional checkpoint resuming
evaluate_gauditrainer: evaluate a trained model on Habana Gaudi using GaudiTrainer.evaluate() with speed metrics tracking
predict_gauditrainer: run inference predictions on a test dataset using GaudiTrainer.predict() with HPU graph acceleration
save_model_gauditrainer: save a trained model checkpoint to disk using GaudiTrainer.save_model() with safetensors support
